finding: Password preparation changed the state but left the Actions framebuffer visible; render_outcome was no_change.
cause: An inventory scene transition fell through into the running survey's selection-only renderer; it then published the new snapshot without painting it.
fix: dev.383 rejects delta rendering across inventory scene discriminators before any selection-only handler.
regression: The runner requires preparation pixels to differ from the prior Actions frame, then remain identical after Right; independent checker rejects the old state-only false positive.
privacy: Raw TFT images, ambient identities and USB metadata remain local; the original run is retained unchanged.
